description: Capture a PNG screenshot of a web page. Operates in two modes: (1) Pass a session_id to screenshot the current page in an active session — use this when you need to see the visual state after interactions. (2) Pass a url without session_id to take a one-shot screenshot without creating a persistent session — use this for quick visual checks. Returns a URL to the screenshot image. Prefer get_a11y_tree over screenshot when you need to read page content, as it uses 77% fewer tokens.

format.description: Image format. In-session mode only. Default: "png".

frame.description: A CSS selector for an iframe, or a list of them for nested iframes. selector, label and ref then resolve inside it.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page, not just the viewport. In-session mode only. Default: false.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

ref.description: An element ref from this page's latest get_a11y_tree, such as e5, or f1e3 inside an iframe.

selector.description: CSS selector to screenshot a specific element instead of the page. In-session mode only.

session_id.description: Browser session ID to screenshot the current page state. Omit for standalone mode.

url.description: URL to screenshot in standalone mode (no persistent session). Ignored if session_id is provided.

name: screenshot
